combined_observations.foreground_cache_observation: Neither named function appears in cache-size snapshots. This is not a measured zero delta.
combined_observations.limitation: Absence of the two named foreground callbacks/cache growth does not establish absence of all compilation or internal specialization. Other named functions and generic stage still trace/lower/load.

filter_only_change.description: Allow existing resident filtering/veto admission when the only original reference operation is waveform. Other reference selectors keep conservative admission, and default routes stay unchanged.
filter_only_change.result: Three timing samples and separate profile measured; prime, all three samples and profile pass exact saved-output comparison with matching frozen baseline runs.

psd_launch_signature.capture: New baseline diagnostic profile, separate from timing samples
psd_launch_signature.limitation: Unfenced host stages select temporal overlap; generic XLA names can collide. The repeated count signature associates the ordered scan with these launches but does not independently establish its wall-time cost.
psd_launch_signature.per_refresh: Two times 3977 loop_add_fusion_1 launches, and two times 3978 loop_add_fusion launches, on each rank.

specialization.cache_hit_caveat: Persistent cache hits can avoid backend code generation while fresh processes still trace, lower and load executables. Backend callback duration does not distinguish uncached code generation from cache retrieval/loading.
specialization.cache_size_caveat: A positive delta establishes new retained dispatcher entries for that call interval; an unchanged positive size shows retention, not a per-call cache-hit counter. Aliases must not be summed.
specialization.duration_caveat: Summed reported callback durations; categories/functions may nest and are not additive wall-time attribution. Percentages use totals within the same recorded category.
specialization.evidence: Three timing samples show function-specific trace, lowering, and backend/cache-load durations plus positive in-process JIT cache-size deltas during query/cluster stages.
